adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck uses documented GET /v1/projects rather than billable listen/speak synthesis.
Returns raw Deepgram JSON under data.
Project ID is URI-encoded. Optional official limit/page query parameters are omitted because the pinned get_project handler does not send them.
Optional includeOutdated is sent as include_outdated=true|false, matching the pinned helper String(boolean) conversion.
